notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #10
notes.notes:
Hello settlers, 🏛️

The Early Access release of Rise of the Settlement is just around the corner!

Over the past weeks I’ve been fully focused on polishing, testing, and squashing bugs to make sure the game feels smooth and stable at launch. My goal is to deliver the best possible experience right from day one, and this stage is all about fine-tuning details, balancing, and adjusting systems so everything works as intended.

It’s a lot of behind-the-scenes work that isn’t flashy, but it’s absolutely crucial for the quality of the game. 



I can mention few updates just to have an ideea of the amount of work:

🎬 Integrated the cutscene intro directly into the game

💧 Added a hydration/thirst system alongside the hunger meter

📜 Polished quests for advanced resources

🏠 Improved the display view of the building list

⚖️ Ensured consistency in showing resource costs

🛠️ Updated the menu buttons: Save, Load, Settings

⚙️ Adjusted several resource production and consumption values


Almost there! 🚀


Thank you for supporting Rise of the Settlement! Don’t forget to share your feedback or questions in the Community Hub or on Discord — your thoughts help me shape the game’s journey.



🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update, the Early Access release, — Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #9
notes.notes:
Greetings, settlers! 🏛️


I’ve been busy adding new features and polishing the experience to make your settlement life more immersive than ever. With Early Access approaching soon, my main focus is now on polishing, bug fixing, and stability improvements, while still adding a few carefully chosen new functionalities to enrich the gameplay. 


🔔 Notification System
You can now stay up to date with everything happening in your settlement.

Quick alerts let you react immediately, while detailed messages give you deeper insights.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/089d8852e64c105ddd2e181f2777ab4895d8491c.png"]
📜 Chronicle Dialog
A living record of your community.

Important events — from villager milestones to settlement progress — are now logged in the Chronicle so you can relive your people’s story.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/739e5b6da391192ce1f5f89ab33ba35dd1790af5.png"]

The more events unfold in your settlement, the richer the Chronicle becomes. Over time it will grow into a living history book of your community, recording the triumphs, struggles, and everyday life of your people. The deeper your journey goes, the more rewarding it will be to look back and see the story of your settlement written across its pages.


🎮 Gameplay & UI Improvements
Better navigation: I refined buttons and layouts for smoother usage.

Tooltips: I added tooltips to many UI buttons so gameplay is clearer and more intuitive.

Objective dialog: Improved navigation and usability, making it easier to focus on what matters next.

Territory & Map icons: Added fresh new images to make these areas feel more alive and thematic. (Note: there won’t be any gameplay features related to maps or territory in the Early Access release — these icons are just early visual work and might be considered a small “spoiler” of what’s to come later.)


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/39b9814de124fe1bf4619f1eb4311b543a4aee9e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/1262099303857292f25da1ccf561db46f56f5c48.png"][/carousel]

💾 Save & Load Enhancements
I fixed and improved several aspects of saving and loading games to ensure a more stable experience - work still in progress


🎶 Immersion Upgrades
Background music has been added to bring your settlement to life.

New settings dialog lets you adjust music volume, and I’ve started work on video settings as well.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/762a91ca75c49b52bb9b4acaab9ec7208b1e1698.png"]
What’s Next?
I’m now preparing the game for its Early Access release. My focus will remain on stability, balance, and polish so the first players can enjoy a smooth experience, while I continue expanding features step by step.

Thank you for supporting Rise of the Settlement! Don’t forget to share your feedback or questions in the Community Hub or on Discord — your thoughts help me shape the game’s journey.



🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update, — Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #8
notes.notes:
Greetings, settlers! 🏛️🌿
The heart of your settlement lies not only in its buildings and resources but in the lives of the people who inhabit it. With this update, I’m excited to share several improvements that bring your villagers’ personal stories to life:


✨ Family & Couples View
Villagers now have improved screens where you can track their relationships.

Affection can be seen growing between individuals, showing how bonds form before they decide to become a couple.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/14de23e6397586388a03d726494b136fbe7e8c2e.png"]
🌳 Family Tree
A new family tree view allows you to follow family lines through generations.

See how households expand, intertwine, and give your settlement a deeper sense of continuity.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/2fee53114e464d92f87ee45a463769df2b207896.png"]
⏳ The Cycle of Life
Your villagers will now age gracefully, and in time, pass on.

This brings a natural rhythm to the community — new generations are born as others leave their mark on history.



These additions aim to make your settlement feel alive, not just in its economy and buildings, but in the human connections that shape its story.

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Community Update #7
notes.notes:
Greetings, settlers! 🏛️🛠️
It’s time to settle in for another development update from Rise of the Settlement!
This time, I’ve entered a consolidation phase — a crucial moment where bugs are squashed, balance is reviewed, and systems are refined. Here’s what’s been going on:


[hr][/hr]

🧹 Polish and Refinement

Many of the recent updates focused on bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and performance tweaks. It’s the kind of work that doesn’t always shine on the surface, but makes the game feel smoother, smarter, and more enjoyable.


🏛️ Introducing the Market


One major addition is the Market — a central structure that changes how your villagers consume goods. Instead of pulling food and resources directly from your total stockpile, villagers now rely on assigned goods in the market.

This change brings clarity and predictability to your settlement’s daily consumption — giving you more control over how resources are distributed and when shortages might occur.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/e7c70515b0df6ae3af161a79a366861a4aa587d3.png"]

This marks the initial concept phase of the Market-type building; further adjustments and refinements are planned. As you can see the first type of Market is called Provision Hall.


🎥 Live Dev Streams & Playtesting


If you're curious how all this works in real time, I often do live development streams where I playtest the game, note down improvements that are needed and bugs that I see, and share design thoughts directly with the community.

These streams are announced on Discord, and you can catch them live here:

👉 [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/lukiandru"][/dynamiclink]



Recent playtest sessions helped uncover and resolve around 100 issues — ranging from minor UI adjustments to deeper, more complex production-related bugs.



Stay tuned — there’s much more to uncover in Rise of the Settlement.

🎮 Please consider joining our community:
👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update,
— Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Community Update #6
notes.notes:
Greetings, settlers! 🏛️🛠️
Trade is emerging as a vital part of your settlement's journey, and I’m excited to share how the new trading system adds both challenge and opportunity to your path forward!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/8d98e3b1ee1d2fac0d7bc0fb6e6e3f7122676765.png"]
🛖 Barter Before Coins


In the early stages of the game, there is no currency — only barter. Trade means exchanging goods for other goods, offering your surplus in return for resources you cannot yet produce.

Some materials, especially early on, are simply unavailable through production. Trading provides a way to acquire those resources until your settlement evolves enough to produce them locally.


🧠 Knowledge Must Be Learned


Your people don’t start with full trading knowledge. At first, they can only trade a few basic goods: wild food, reeds, and water — and those goods are cheap. Unlocking more valuable trade options requires research and development.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/416979e1c91d03e3622feaf80514fb96c77e193c.png"]

🔍 Unclear at First...


At first, your people have little understanding of trade value — you won’t see exact exchange rates, only rough outcomes. But as your society researches and gains trading knowledge - Barter Intuition, you’ll unlock clearer insights into resource values, helping you make smarter trade decisions.


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/5c0ead07ec4978a6ce6cf7e7f201f9eed15332b8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/7779a1b5054da5906fd484c015da65f443461424.png"][/carousel]

📉📈 A Dynamic Market


Trade isn’t static. The market is shaped by supply and demand, meaning exchange rates shift based on availability. Oversupplying the market with one good will devalue it, while rare items hold strong.
🏛️ The Barter Hall


Through tech progression, you’ll unlock the Barter Hall, a unique building where you can train messengers and promote new goods for trade. This transforms raw materials into recognized tradeable assets — essential if you want to access higher-tier exchanges.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/d470ec43a3283eb501b1546acf7c62d5705e68e0.png"]



💰 For the future - From Barter to Currency


Eventually, through deeper research, your settlement will discover currency. This will usher in a new era of trading, with structured pricing, standardized value, and more complex market strategies.


[hr][/hr]
Stay tuned — there’s much more to uncover in Rise of the Settlement.

🎮 Please consider joining our community:
👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update,
— Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #5
notes.notes:
Greetings, settlers!🏛️🛠️


I am excited to share big strides made in shaping the heart of your settlement: the people who live, work, and grow within it. The world is no longer empty—your villagers now have names, faces, stories, and needs!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/c3efbc45db2964a9f4bbe6bb466c0ad4b6e791eb.png"]


👪 A Living Population
Villagers are now born, grow up, age, and eventually pass on. Your settlement is no longer static—it’s alive with generations.

🍼 Children go through distinct life stages: baby, toddler, teen, and adult. Each stage affects their appearance, behavior, and abilities.

🧒 Only adults can work, while teens may help in limited ways in future updates.

📸 Every villager has a unique hand-drawn portrait that reflects their age and identity, helping you connect with the people you’re guiding.

These life cycles add depth to your village, and you’ll start to feel the story of each family unfold over time.


❤️ Relationships & Families
Villagers now form couples and start families, allowing your population to grow naturally over time through generations.

💑 When two adults pair up, they may eventually have children, beginning the next chapter in your village’s story.

👶 Pregnancies, births, and birthdays now trigger meaningful changes—from new villagers entering the world to children aging into useful members of the community.

🧬 Family ties also influence legacy traits, such as inherited profession tendencies, making lineage a core part of long-term development.

As families grow, your village begins to feel truly alive—woven together by bonds of work, survival, and heritage.


💼 Work and Skills
Your villagers now learn by doing. As they work, they gain experience tied to the job they perform—whether it's gathering, farming, building, or crafting.

🪓 Experience accumulates over time, and once a threshold is reached, the villager is granted a profession title such as Apprentice, Journeyman, or Master.

⚙️ Each title level brings an increase in job efficiency, making skilled workers much more valuable.

🧬 Professions can also be inherited as legacy traits from parents. A child born to skilled workers may begin life with an innate talent in that profession, giving them a head start.

Over time, you'll develop a population of highly specialized villagers, shaped by their experiences—and their bloodlines.


😊 Happiness and Needs
Villagers now have basic survival needs—specifically food and water. These are essential for maintaining their health and happiness.

🍎 If food or water is missing, villagers will become unhappy.

The system is already built to support more needs in the future, such as clothing, shelter, and social fulfillment.

While only the most essential needs are active right now, this lays the groundwork for a deeper simulation of village life, where wellbeing becomes as important as work.


📸 A Village of Faces
I've added a large variety of hand-drawn villager portraits, tailored to each life stage. Babies are swaddled in linen, teens sport youthful looks, and elders wear the years with pride.

These portraits will grow with your people, making your community feel alive and personal.



I’ve laid the foundation for deeper simulation and emergent stories. In the coming time, I’ll be expanding on:

Housing & living space systems

Individual equipment and clothing

Social dynamics and personal preferences

Thanks for following development and being part of this journey.





Stay tuned — there’s much more to uncover in Rise of the Settlement.

🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update,  — Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #4
notes.notes:
Hello Settlers! 🌿🏛️
Welcome to our fourth Dev Diary update! Today, we're diving into one of the most exciting systems behind the growth of your village: the Technology Tree — the roadmap of progress in Rise of the Settlement.


🌱 What is the Tech Tree?
The Technology Tree is your village’s path from humble beginnings to an organized and flourishing society. Each discovery in the tech tree unlocks new buildings, quests, production recipes — expanding both your strategy and your story. More to come...

You’ll begin in a primitive age, where survival is key. As you advance, your people will master new skills, refine resources, and even unlock governance and trade systems.


🔧 What Technologies Unlock
Every technology node brings new gameplay:

🛖 New buildings (e.g., Clay Kiln, Smokehouse, Trade Post)

📈 Production efficiency improvements

🧭 Expeditions, quests, and deeper economic systems

🧠 Hidden synergies that evolve based on your choices

💱 Trading mechanics, including barter systems, market unlocks, and dynamic prices — all gated behind specific tech discoveries

🧩 Additional quest slots, expanding the number of active missions you can manage — unlocked through tech and story progression

As always, this is just the begining.


🖼️ Visual Tech Tree – In Progress!
I am working on a fully interactive Tech Tree UI, styled like a parchment scroll with ink-drawn connections between technologies. It will make it easy to track what you've unlocked — and what lies ahead.

We're also planning:

Unique branches based on how your settlement develops (e.g. agrarian vs industrial paths)

Unlock requirements tied to population growth, profession levels, or previous quests

Tooltips and progress tracking to plan your strategy

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/5f5af90d34d34ee290f0f825b90811a61556ecab.png"]
🛠️ What’s Next?
I am currently refining:

Research speed and balance

Early and mid-game tech pacing

How technologies interact with villager skills

This is a living system, and we’ll keep updating it based on your feedback and playstyle.



Thanks again for walking the path of progress with me.

Stay tuned — there’s much more to uncover in Rise of the Settlement.

🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update,  — Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #3
notes.notes:
A new chapter begins for your settlement — one of opportunity, challenges, and choice.

With this update, we're introducing the Quest System, allowing your community to take on meaningful tasks in exchange for growth, bonuses, and unique rewards. Whether you're gathering food, preparing for winter, or embarking on expeditions, quests will give purpose to your people’s actions — and yours.


📜 What's In This Update?


Quests and Missions concept is implemented and ready to be used — and extended further with new quests, expanded missions, and awesome additions like story-driven arcs, rare rewards, and dynamic world events.

✅ Production Quests

Support your settlement's economy by fulfilling requests like gathering wood, harvesting crops, or crafting basic goods.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/74857bfae5f417c9e6eadb8bba9765363842f0f7.jpg"]
✅ Expedition Quests

Assign villagers to risky ventures like searching for seeds, exploring the unknown, or trading with distant groups. Success is never guaranteed — but the rewards can be game-changing.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/9eaa5c8d25681aae06a612d9b223844a5074f444.jpg"]


✅ Feast Quests

Celebrate the abundance of food by hosting a feast. If word spreads, new villagers may be drawn to your growing community.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/cd72ce9e6b83e64ccf53c8ae66e964d6c1681c01.jpg"]


✅ Quest Slots System


You can have up to 6 quests active at the same time, managed through quest slots. Slots unlock progressively through the technology tree, letting you build a rhythm of multiple ongoing tasks and long-term strategies.


✅ Seasonal Rotation & Progression


Quests evolve with the seasons and your technological progress — making each campaign feel alive and responsive.
You’ll encounter:

Monthly Quests that refresh every in-game month

Seasonal Quests tied to the current season (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter)

Themed Quests that appear only in specific months or specific seasons — each with its own unique flavor and rewards

This system ensures that the challenges your settlement faces shift over time, encouraging you to adapt, plan ahead, and make the most of every opportunity.

We’ve just begun — but there’s already plenty to do:

21 Production Quests — covering everything from basic gathering to more specialized resource tasks

4 Feast Quests — where you trade food for the chance to grow your population

1 Expedition Quest — send villagers out to search for rare seeds and grains

This is just the start. More quests, more types, and deeper questlines are already in development!


🧭 Choices Matter
Many quests offer options — choose which resource to pursue, which people to send, and when to act. Every decision shapes the outcome, and some quests may fail or be delayed if your village isn't ready.


🔍 How to Access Quests?
Quests are found in the Quests Panel, which unlocks early in your gameplay. As new buildings and techs are discovered, more quests will become available.

🎁 This is just the beginning! We’re building a living quest system that will grow with future updates, introducing storylines, faction interaction, and larger expedition arcs.

Stay tuned — and may your choices bring fortune to your people.



🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update,  — Luki

notes.title: Rise of the Settlement – Dev Diary Community Update #2
notes.notes:
Buildings are at the heart of your settlement’s growth and survival. In this update, we’re introducing the foundational system that allows you to plan, place, and operate your early infrastructure—from gathering food to producing materials vital for expansion.


Currently Implemented Production Buildings (June 2025)


Here's a categorized breakdown based on what you’ve implemented:

🍎 Food Production & Gathering

Forager Hut – Collects wild food and branches

Fishing Lodge – Provides a steady source of fish

Hunting Lodge – For meat and animal products

Orchard – Produces fruits like apples or grapes

Farm – Cultivates crops like wheat, barley, etc.

Homestead Garden - Grows vegetables like onion, garlic etc

Hop Yard, Vineyard, Flax Farm – Specialized farming for production chains

🪵 Basic Resource Extraction

Woodcutter Lodge – Cuts trees for wood

Reed Pond – Collects reeds for crafting

Quarry, Mine – Stone, clay, or metal ore

Pit Kiln – Converts clay into pottery or bricks

🔥 Processing & Crafting

Drying Hut, Smokehouse – Preserves food

Steaming Hut, Threshing Shed – Processing crops like flax or grains

Primitive Workshop – Creates early tools and basic items


Production UI – Work in Progress Preview


One of the core gameplay systems in Rise of the Settlement is resource production and management. Under the Production tab, players will be able to monitor all active buildings that contribute to the growth and sustainability of the settlement.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/406593428423a54e5c581427890512e17aae6bbd.png"]

Each building appears as a card, showing:

A card visual of the structure

The building's name (e.g., FishingLodge, PrimitiveWorkshop)

Live production status (e.g., Fish – 36%, Reeds – 40%)

At a glance, players can see what's operating, what's idle, and what needs attention


Spotlight: The Primitive Workshop


Once constructed, the Primitive Workshop becomes the beating heart of early survival crafting. From crude baskets to stone tools and simple traps, this is where raw resources like branches and reeds are transformed into usable goods.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657259/58e9f57569ef1f193fb472f3f9f5710849600d5c.png"]
🎯 Features Highlighted in the Panel:
✅ Active Production Slots
Each building have one or more production slots, meaning some goods can be produced based on player selection. 

✅ Detailed Resource Requirements & Time
Each item shows exactly what it costs and how long it takes to be produced and the outcome count.

✅ Worker Management
Players can assign specific settlers to work in the building. Here, John and Claude Alvaro are hard at work. Workers stats affects the production time.

✅ Production enhancements
Below the main panel, a parchment-like UI lets players enable "Knotted Focus" enhance specific outputs—this system is still in development to balance the cost and boosts, but already hints at deep strategy.

⚒️ Building upgrades - not yet implemented Future updates will allow players to unlock additional features or increase efficiency through building upgrades and levels.  



🎮 Please consider joining our community: 

👉 https://discord.com/invite/WSdrFVX9Ys



See you in the next update, 
— Luki
